Business Experience → AI Opportunity

THE AI HOUSE

Understand RAG, GenAI and Agentic AI like building a house.

For PNP-BAI Product Type implementations, we explain the three complementary AI layers using a memorable house analogy:

🍳

Kitchen — RAG AI

Brings trusted enterprise and industry knowledge into the product so AI can work with grounded, relevant context.

KNOWLEDGE LAYER
🛁

Bathroom — GenAI

Transforms context into useful intelligence, summaries, recommendations, content and structured business outputs.

INTELLIGENCE LAYER
🛋️

Living Room — Agentic AI

Coordinates tools, workflows, actions and human approvals so intelligence can move into controlled execution.

ACTION LAYER
This three-layer PNP-BAI model reflects the broader industry movement from generative AI toward reasoning and agentic AI highlighted by NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang in his San Jose keynote. AI FoundryCamp uses RAG AI, GenAI and Agentic AI together as complementary layers of a business AI product.

PATH 3

Two Build Paths

Start with a proven pattern—or build your own.

PATH A · FASTEST TO PROOF OF VALUE

PNP-BAI Business Product

For teams with a business problem that do not want to invent an AI architecture from scratch.

  • Define Business Product Type and KPIs
  • Configure enterprise and industry knowledge
  • RAG retrieval and grounded context
  • GenAI reasoning and Business Atomic Intelligence
  • Agentic workflows with human approval
Enterprise / Industry Data → RAG → GenAI → Business Atomic Intelligence → Agentic AI → Human Approval / Action
PATH B · CUSTOM PRODUCT

Build Your Own AI Product

For teams pursuing a differentiated AI solution in cybersecurity, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, logistics and other sectors.

  • Business goal and measurable KPI
  • Requirements and solution architecture
  • Models, agents, RAG and integrations
  • Implementation, testing and deployment
  • EAAP governance or a manual toolchain
Goal → KPI → Requirements → Architecture → Models & Agents → Implementation → Test → Deploy → Measure

AWS Funding Readiness

Build evidence that strengthens the next funding conversation.

Current AWS Activate landscape

AWS currently offers startup credits through AWS Activate. AI FoundryCamp can help a participant organize the technical and business evidence needed for an application, but AWS alone determines eligibility and approval.

Activate FoundersFor qualifying self-funded startups. AWS currently advertises an initial $1,000 in credits, with select participants potentially qualifying for up to $5,000.
Activate PortfolioFor qualifying startups affiliated with an AWS Activate Provider and using the provider's Organization ID. AWS currently advertises credits up to $200,000 depending on eligibility and startup stage.
AI Startup GrowthAWS states that additional credits may be available for AI startups ready to scale beyond Activate tiers; engagement with AWS or an account team may be required.

Important: AI FoundryCamp is an independent service and is not AWS or an AWS credit-granting entity. No funding or credit amount is guaranteed. Program terms, eligibility and amounts can change.
